chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"If a male beggar comes to you at night, do not turn him away."

key_terms.سَائِلٌ: a beggar or petitioner asking for help
key_terms.طَرَقَكُمْ: came to you suddenly or knocked upon you
key_terms.فَلَا تَرُدُّوهُ: do not turn him away or refuse him

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say about a male beggar who comes at night?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches compassion and responsiveness toward those in need, especially when they come at night in a vulnerable state. It emphasizes not rejecting a male petitioner who seeks help at such a time, reflecting the Prophetic concern for charity and social care.
